items.quote: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
items.claim: The text says God heard the groaning of an unnamed group ('their') and remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
items.action: heard their groaning and remembered his covenant
items.object: covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
items.mechanism: God hearing their groaning comes right before he remembers the covenant. The text puts the two side by side but does not say one caused the other.
